session.instructions:
An original adult female voice in her mid-twenties, speaking native standard Japanese. Radiant, glamorous, honey-warm mid register with a relaxed, languid, affectionately coaxing drawl. Lush and silky timbre, unhurried tempo, softly elongated vowels and a breathy, playful sweet-spoiled lilt at the ends of phrases, effortlessly charming and at ease.
Speak immediately in Japanese. Say exactly this line once: "きゃああああっ！！ も、もっと強く抱いてええっ……離さないでええっ！！". Do not translate, paraphrase, repeat, or add words. Then remain silent. Delivery direction: MAXIMUM INTENSITY, loud full-throated high-pitched anime scream! Soaring soprano head-voice belt with dramatic vibrato and desperate emotional power — NEVER whisper! No music or background noise.
